import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String a = scanner.nextLine();
        int n = a.length();
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        b.append(a.charAt(0));
        int l = 1;
        int i = 1;
        while (i < n) {
            if (i < n - 1 && a.charAt(i) == 'a' && a.charAt(i + 1) == 't' && l == 1) {
                b.append('@');
                i += 2;
                l = 0;
            } else if (i < n - 2 && a.charAt(i) == 'd' && a.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && a.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                b.append('.');
                i += 3;
            } else {
                b.append(a.charAt(i));
                i++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(b.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
